name: task
description: Task workflows and opt-in Timeline recording backed by the track CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Manage checklist tasks and record selected work in Track Timeline.
interface.longDescription: Triage work, maintain project checklists, and move completed tasks into dated worklogs. When requested, record milestones and completed-interval reports in the selected Track Timeline project.
defaultPrompt: Use $track-task-triage to triage this TODO by size and route it.
Use $track-task-runner to work through my project note's checklist.
Use $track-timeline to record progress in an existing Track Timeline project.
